drafted_from: tool:read-service-usage's own row and test/read-service-usage.test.mjs, whose packaged row run answered the refusal shown here
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the provider usage for service_connection:cloudflare:one from 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28." It runs tool:read-service-usage on that one connection and answers its counter samples, or unread with the reason.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads one connected account at the provider and answers the samples without saving them.
instructions: 1. Pick the connection to read (connection_id, a service_connection id) and the inclusive UTC dates since and until (YYYY-MM-DD).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-service-usage and { connection_id, since, until }.
3. Read state: read gives usage and period; unread gives a reason (invalid_scope, provider_unreadable) and no counts, never a zero.
4. To keep reading it on a schedule, hand the same connection to tool:keep-service-usage-watches.

worked_examples.title: An impossible date is refused before any provider call
worked_examples.ask: Read my Cloudflare usage from February 30 to February 28.
worked_examples.given: From test/read-service-usage.test.mjs: the packaged row run with since 2026-02-30 opens no held pipe and sends nothing.
